notes: KG Triumph Scanner v0.3.5 Build 15 fixes diagnostic report saving. A timestamped local report is preserved before export, the dialog starts in the local reports folder, and denied/locked destinations retain the report for retry. Existing reports are protected against failed replacements. The raw CAN engine transport is retained; the shop's keyed Trident has returned VIN and live readings through SM3 USB at 500 kbps with 29-bit addressing. Triumph proprietary discovery and key programming/pairing writes are not implemented.
